UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile details including email or phone number and selected plan

planExpiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the active paid plan expires

autoPayEnabled.description: Whether recurring AutoPay renewal is enabled for the active membership

autoPayStatus.description: Current status of the AutoPay mandate

subscriptionId.description: Razorpay subscription or AutoPay mandate reference ID

autoPayUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when AutoPay state was last changed

lastPaymentAmount.description: Latest Razorpay payment amount in the user's payment currency

lastPaymentCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the latest payment (e.g. INR, USD, GBP, CAD)

paymentHistory.description: Recent Razorpay payment and pro-rata refund records

SiteView.title: SiteView
SiteView.description: Website visit analytics record with administrative location (country, state, district, taluka) and visit timestamp

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the visitor

visitedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the website view occurred

locationSource.description: Location resolution method: device geolocation (gps), postal pincode (pincode), or ISP IP fallback (ip)

accuracyMeters.description: Optional geolocation accuracy radius in meters

locationCleared.description: Whether location details were cleared by admin while preserving the visit count

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile and plan subscription settings

/site_views/{viewId}.description: Stores website visit counts, administrative locations, and timestamps
